contentSummary: First listing content finalization is not ready. This workspace organizes the title, keyword strategy, description, item specifics, category, condition, pricing placeholder, shipping and returns readiness, compliance notes and image copy readiness without creating a draft or copying competitor content.

contentSections.label: Title
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Validate a title using confirmed Portex facts and approved generic traffic keywords.

contentSections.label: Subtitle
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Decide whether a subtitle is needed after title and category review.

contentSections.label: Category
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Confirm the eBay category against the product use case and Portex product facts.

contentSections.label: Item Specifics
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Validate dimensions, materials, compatibility and technical facts against Portex.

contentSections.label: Condition
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Confirm item condition before final content or draft mapping.

contentSections.label: Description
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Write original description copy based on Portex facts and approved buyer benefits.

contentSections.label: Pricing
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Approve cost, margin, fees and shipping cost before pricing copy is final.

contentSections.label: Shipping and Returns
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Confirm shipping and return policies before final content.

contentSections.label: Compliance and Risk
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Review compliance, VeRO, claims and competitor keyword risk.

contentSections.label: Image Copy Readiness
contentSections.requiredToUnlock: Approve image source and QA before any image copy or captions are final.

keywordIntelligencePolicy.coreRule: Use market intelligence, do not copy competitor content.
allowed: Use generic, relevant and truthful traffic keywords.
Use competitor listings as benchmark signals.
Use category, price range and item-specific patterns as references.
Classify keywords as core, secondary, risk or blocked.
Use a winning keyword when the underlying product fact is confirmed by Portex.
blocked: Do not copy full competitor titles.
Do not use competitor brand names as keywords unless legally allowed and reviewed.
Do not treat competitor dimensions or facts as truth unless confirmed by Portex.

requiredHumanActions: Validate product title using confirmed Portex facts.
Approve keyword strategy before final title.
Confirm pricing, margin, fees and shipping cost.
Complete compliance and VeRO risk review.
Approve image source and image QA.
Keep eBay draft creation blocked until all gates are approved.
nextRecommendedAction: Finalize original listing content only after product facts, keyword strategy, commercial readiness, image QA, shipping, returns and compliance review are approved.
